title: migrate OkHttp2 to OkHttp3
body:
[Some classes](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/search?q=com.squareup.okhttp) still using `com.squareup.okhttp` (v2.x) which is [deprecated since 2016](https://square.github.io/okhttp/changelog_3x/#version-300-rc1). Many others using the newer v3.x. Using both major versions within a project can cause strange problems like https://github.com/square/okhttp/issues/2705.
We should migrate the code using the deprecated version to v3.

comments.body: The [best practice in OkHttp 3](https://square.github.io/okhttp/changelogs/changelog_3x/#version-300-rc1) is to create a single OkHttpClient instance and share it throughout the application. Requests that needs a customized client should call OkHttpClient.newBuilder() on that shared instance. This allows customization without the drawbacks of separate connection pools.
